The stem and leaf plot shows the pressure in pounds per square inch of each bicycle tire in a shop.

Bicycle Tire Pressures

Stem | Leaf
5 | 0 9 9
6 | 5
7 | 2 4 6
8 | 3 5 7 7 7 8 9
9 | 1 2 3 4 6 9

5|9 means 59 pounds per square inch.

Which statement is best supported by the data in the stem and leaf plot?

options.label: F
options.text: Half of the tire pressures are 75 pounds per square inch or less.

options.label: G
options.text: There are more tires with pressures from 90 to 99 pounds per square inch than with pressures from 80 to 89 pounds per square inch.

options.label: H
options.text: Three times as many tires have pressures from 50 to 59 pounds per square inch as tires that have a pressure of 65 pounds per square inch.

options.label: J
options.text: There are more tires with pressures from 70 to 79 pounds per square inch than with pressures from 50 to 59 pounds per square inch.
